final: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY film_id), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM actor_counts), first_kept AS (SELECT ac.actor_count FROM actor_counts ac CROSS JOIN first_average a WHERE ac.actor_count > a.avg_count), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM first_kept) SELECT SUM(fk.actor_count) AS total_actor_count, AVG(fk.actor_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_excess_over_first, AVG(fk.actor_count - b.avg_count) AS avg_excess_over_second FROM first_kept fk CROSS JOIN first_average a CROSS JOIN second_average b WHERE fk.actor_count > b.avg_count
